get.summary: The signed-in crew member's own unit totals. Same dates as /api/crew/units.

post.summary: Signs in with email and password and sets the session cookie.
Changes the signed-in user's own password.

get.summary: Every job for one day, in order. Defaults to today.

post.summary: Marks a job done by a crew member.

put.summary: Checks or unchecks an item on the loading list.

get.summary: Bookings whose setup falls between two dates (inclusive). Defaults to the next 14 days.

post.summary: Creates a booking with its setup and pickup jobs.

put.summary: Replaces a booking's details, schedule, crew, and items. Loaded checks are kept for items still on it.

get.summary: Units on completed jobs per crew member between two dates (inclusive). Defaults to this weekend, Friday through Monday.
How many of each active item are free between setupAt and pickupAt. Pass excludeBookingId when editing a booking.

post.summary: Adds or updates many items at once, matched by name (ignoring case). Items not in the list are left alone.

put.summary: Updates an item. Retire items with isActive=false instead of deleting so past bookings keep their history.
Sets the item's photo. Send the image bytes as the request body (JPEG, PNG, or WebP, up to 3 MB).
Changes name, role, crew link, or disables the account. You cannot demote or disable yourself.

post.summary: Sets a new password for someone who forgot theirs.
